full_prompt_en: A square decorative illustration centers a golden horse's head among dense jewel-toned foliage and small blue birds. The horse turns three-quarters toward the right, its long pale-gold muzzle extending across the central area to a dark nostril near the lower right. One large blue-black eye looks outward from beneath a sharply angled brow. Tall pointed ears rise toward the top edge, while flowing strands of ocher, cream, and pale blue mane sweep leftward into the surrounding leaves. The neck and cheek are built from overlapping orange, amber, rust, and olive planes, with fine stipples and curved linework giving them a textured surface. On the left, a large fan of elongated leaves crosses in front of the mane. Teal, muted turquoise, ocher, violet, and warm red leaf shapes alternate, many carrying fine veins and short parallel marks. A tiny blue-green bird sits near the upper-left corner among pale flowing bands. Below the horse's jaw, another brighter turquoise bird looks upward from the dark foliage, its slim beak and single round eye plainly visible. Slender stems, seed heads, and pointed leaves fill gaps along the right edge and lower field. Behind them, deep navy and nearly black zones make the warm head and cool leaves shine without turning the whole picture bright. Swirling blue lines near the top lead the eye around the pointed ears and down toward the horse's face. The shallow space is made by overlap and color contrast, with no realistic horizon or cast shadows. Even graphic light gives the yellow-orange planes a luminous quality against the dark base. The overall composition is intricate and intimate, using the head's smooth diagonal form to organize abundant curling, finely patterned vegetation.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形装饰插画把金色马首置于密集的宝石色枝叶与蓝色小鸟之间。马以四分之三角度朝右转，长长浅金色嘴部从中央伸向右下附近的深色鼻孔。一只蓝黑大眼从明显倾斜的眉线下望向画外。高而尖的耳朵向上缘竖起，赭黄、奶油色和浅蓝色的鬃毛流向左侧，与周围叶片相接。颈部与脸颊由相叠的橙色、琥珀、锈色和橄榄色体面组成，细小点触与弯曲线条让表面富有肌理。左侧一大扇修长叶片横过鬃毛前方。青绿、低饱和绿松石色、赭黄、紫色与暖红叶形交替，许多带有细叶脉和短平行线。左上角一只小蓝绿色鸟停在浅色流动色带间。马下颌下方，另一只更亮的青绿鸟从深色枝叶中向上看，细鸟喙和一颗圆眼清楚可见。细茎、种子头和尖叶填满右缘及下方间隙。其后深海军蓝和近黑区域让暖色马首与冷叶发亮，却没有把整幅画抬得过亮。顶部盘旋蓝线引导视线绕过尖耳，落向马脸。浅层空间由叠压与颜色反差建立，没有写实地平线或投影。均匀的图形化光照让黄橙体面在深底上呈发亮效果。整体构图精细而亲近，以马首平滑的斜向形体组织丰盛、卷曲且纹样细密的植被。
style_prompt_en: The decorative illustration layers flowing organic shapes over a deep navy-black ground. Golden yellow, amber, ocher, rust, teal, turquoise, and violet alternate in close clusters, making warm and cool passages enhance each other. Large smooth diagonals are surrounded by smaller pointed forms and sweeping curved bands. Fine stippling, veins, short parallel strokes, and intricate line texture distinguish adjacent surfaces without breaking their strong silhouettes. Dark negative channels remain visible between crowded forms, adding depth and preventing the detailed pattern from becoming flat noise. Illumination is even and color-driven, with pale gold and saturated cool accents appearing luminous against the dark base rather than receiving realistic highlights. Overlap creates shallow space, and repeated curves carry the eye across it. The overall effect is ornate and vivid, with disciplined shape flow and textured color giving a dreamlike surface strong visual order.
style_prompt_zh: 这种装饰插画把流动的有机形状层层铺在深海军蓝黑色底面上。金黄、琥珀、赭黄、锈色、青绿、绿松石色和紫色在紧密色群中交替，让冷暖区域互相衬托。宽大平滑的斜形被较小尖形与扫过的曲线色带环绕。细密点触、叶脉状线、短平行笔迹和复杂线性肌理区分相邻表面，却不打碎有力剪影。深色负空间通道仍能从拥挤形状之间显现，增加层次，也避免精密纹样变成平面噪声。光照均匀，由色彩驱动，浅金与饱和冷色重音在深底上显得发亮，而非接受写实高光。叠压造出浅层空间，反复曲线引导视线穿行其中。整体效果华丽鲜艳，以有纪律的形体流向和有肌理的色彩让梦幻表面保持强烈秩序。
theme_en: A golden horse's head among jewel-toned leaves and small blue birds
theme_zh: 金色马首置于宝石色枝叶与蓝色小鸟之间
name: Alida Akers
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
